{{Top|leg}}
'''Solar smelters''' were high-power industrial equipment utilized by the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When the Jawas came across salvage and junk that they could not repair and was considered unsalvageable, they used the solar smelters to melt down the scrap, converting it into ingots.<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
